mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, product_id, rating, content, image, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{image}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, r.product_id AS productId, r.rating, r.content, r.image, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC
